name: DexVault
author: Renault John Lecoultre
description: Hands DexVault everything Navidrome tells about every account: each play, what starts playing, playback reports, and every hour each account's library with its plays, stars and hearts

users.reason: Report the plays and libraries of the accounts assigned to the plugin

subsonicapi.reason: Read each account's library as it sees it: plays, stars and hearts are kept per account

http.reason: Send the reports to DexVault, which runs beside Navidrome on the home network

url.title: DexVault address
url.description: Where Navidrome reaches DexVault; on the same Docker network, http://dexvault:3001

token.title: Token
token.description: The same secret as NAVIDROME_PLUGIN_TOKEN in the DexVault stack
